recognize_zh: 皮膚真皮內瀰漫的中大型母細胞，核形明顯不規則（摺疊、拉長、腎形），染色質細、核仁不明顯，細胞質淡而空，間質少量粉紅膠原，無明顯發炎或壞死，形態上屬非特異性母細胞浸潤，符合 BPDCN 皮膚病灶。
features: Dense diffuse infiltrate of medium-to-large blastoid cells dissecting between collagen
Pleomorphic, irregular nuclei with folded, elongated, and kidney-shaped contours
Fine chromatin and small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant-to-moderate pale, finely vacuolated agranular cytoplasm
Scant intervening eosinophilic dermal collagen; no necrosis, angiocentricity, or eosinophils
describe_en: High-power H&E section of a skin biopsy shows the dermis replaced by a diffuse infiltrate of medium-to-large blastoid cells separated by scant eosinophilic collagen. Nuclei are irregular and frequently folded or elongated, with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and the cytoplasm is pale and agranular. There is no necrosis, angiodestruction, or significant mixed inflammatory infiltrate. The morphology alone is nonspecific, but with a CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ immunophenotype lacking myeloid and lymphoid lineage markers, findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia cutis with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic leukemia cutis shows lysozyme, CD14/CD163 and often MPO expression, whereas BPDCN is MPO/lysozyme negative with strong CD123, TCF4 and TCL1.
PTCL usually includes a mixed inflammatory background and expresses surface CD3 with clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas BPDCN lacks CD3 and shows a pure blastic population.
ENKTL is angiocentric and necrotic with EBER positivity, features absent here.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells have vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are CD20+/PAX5+/MUM1+, unlike B-lineage-negative BPDCN.
